blogs.title: Beyond the Ulcer: When Hyponatremia Signals Acute Neuro-Behçet's
blogs.description: Explore the diagnostic trap where classic Behçet's disease (oral/genital ulcers) co-exists with acute neurological involvement before structural brain lesions appear on MRI. This post analyzes why 'normal' imaging does not rule out Neuro-BD and emphasizes the critical role of recognizing SIADH-associated hyponatremia as a sentinel sign of impending meningeal inflammation.

blogs.title: The Silent Culprit: Unmasking SIADH in Systemic Autoimmunity
blogs.description: Deep dive into the pathophysiological link between CNS inflammation and Syndrome of Inappropriate Antidiuresis Hormone (SIADH). Discuss mechanisms involving Interleukin-6 and hypothalamic irritation in Non-infectious Meningoencephalitis, moving beyond the standard workup for infection or malignancy to recognize primary immune-mediated hormonal derangement.

blogs.title: More Than Just Headache: Hidden Clues Like Rhabdo and Hiccups in Electrolyte Disturbances
blogs.description: Review the subtle, multi-system manifestations of severe hyponatremia often missed in busy ED settings. Using this case, illustrate how persistent hiccups (a classic medullary sign) and unexpected rhabdomyolysis (elevated CK) can be direct consequences of SIADH-driven neuronal dysfunction, serving as red flags for rapid investigation even without overt neurological deficit.

blogs.title: Steroids vs. Colchicine? Re-evaluating First-Line Therapy for Mild-Acute Neuro-Behçet's
blogs.description: Challenge the dogma that acute Neuro-Behçet's requires aggressive pulse steroids or chemotherapy immediately. Present evidence from this unique case where colchicine monotherapy successfully reversed neurological symptoms and restored normonatremia, sparking a discussion on risk-stratifying patients and sparing toxic side-effects in those with primarily meningeal rather than parenchymal involvement.
